changes.text: The Extension compiles each authorized tab into one canonical full semantic view and then pushes meaningful revision-bounded deltas to the loopback Node Broker.
changes.previousText: The Extension compiles each authorized tab into one canonical full semantic view and then pushes meaningful revision-bounded deltas.

changes.text: Geometry changes update the same object identity; document replacement creates a new document boundary and invalidates stale authority. Replacement never rebinds an old object or action token.
changes.previousText: Geometry changes update the same object identity; document replacement creates a new document boundary and invalidates stale authority.

changes.text: Editable values, protected values, cookies, storage, DOM paths, locators, screenshots, and arbitrary JavaScript are never exposed as Truth.
changes.previousText: Editable values, protected values, cookies, storage, DOM paths, and locators are never exposed as Truth.

changes.text: Stream gaps and impossible revisions force an exact-tab reset rather than guessed state. Delta requests never silently become full reads.
changes.previousText: Stream gaps and impossible revisions force an exact-tab reset rather than guessed state.

changes.text: The Broker keeps one canonical current Truth per exact tab. Full reads return a bounded full view or complete compact catalog; delta reads wait locally for pushed change and return only provably continuous changes.
Semantic queries return a bounded working set or bounded candidates and never become selectors or execution authority.
Action receipts may carry value-free relevant deltas and verified semantic postconditions so an Agent does not need a redundant follow-up read.
